name: ai-review-agent
description: Local AI code review — run a 15-agent Ollama swarm on your staged changes. testgen is opt-in.

aiReview.model.description: Ollama model to use for code review

aiReview.agents.description: Agents to run. Empty array runs all 15 default agents. testgen is always excluded (opt-in via CLI only). Valid: security, performance, correctness, design, dependencies, coverage, adversarial, integration, breaking-change, license, error-handling, observability, migration-safety, secrets, complexity

enumDescriptions: No profile — use agents list or all 15 defaults
change-review: 8 agents for PR review (~10-15 min)
aiReview.profile.description: Named agent subset to run. Overrides aiReview.agents if set.

enumDescriptions: Load relevant memory-bank files per agent (static routing)
Load memory-bank files ranked by semantic similarity (requires nomic-embed-text)
aiReview.contextMode.description: Context mode for --context flag. Requires memory-bank/ in project root.

aiReview.maxLines.description: Maximum diff lines to send for review

aiReview.timeout.description: Per-agent timeout in seconds (passed to CLI as milliseconds)
